qualification.details: Chief General Manager Level: For applicants working in IDA scale/PSUs: 20 years executive experience (10 years relevant), min 4 years in IDA pay scale of equivalent to ₹120000-280000 or above. For consolidated pay, min 4 years in GM grade & CTC of ₹ 2,50,000 per month. For applicants working in the CDA scale: 20 years executive experience (10 years relevant), min 4 years at Pay Matrix Level 14 NFSAG grade under the 7th CPC or equivalent. Candidates from private industries: 23 years executive experience (10 years relevant), min CTC of ₹ 2,50,000 per month. General Manager Level: For applicants working in IDA scale/PSUs: 17 years executive experience (10 years relevant), working in IDA pay scale of equivalent to ₹120000-280000 or must have at least 2 years in the IDA pay scale of ₹100000-260000 or above. For consolidated pay, min CTC of ₹ 2,25,000 per month in GM grade. For applicants working in the CDA scale: 17 years post-qualification executive experience (10 years relevant), at pay matrix level 14 (SAG/NFSAG) or equivalent or working for at least 2 years at level 13/13A or an equivalent scale under the 7th CPC. Candidates from private industries: 20 years executive experience (10 years relevant), min CTC of ₹ 2,25,000 per month.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the GMRC Chief General Manager/General Manager (Corporate Planning) post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 09 October 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Graduate engineering degree in Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, or Electronics & Communications discipline. Officers from Railway in specific grades are also preferred.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 57 years for contract positions and 58 years for deputation positions.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for the GMRC Chief General Manager/General Manager (Corporate Planning) role?
faq.answer: The selection process includes Personal Interviews, Document Verification, and a Medical Examination.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Chief General Manager/General Manager (Corporate Planning) post?
faq.answer: For contract positions, the salary is as per the IDA scale of ₹120000-280000. For deputation, it will be as per the terms and conditions.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Chief General Manager/General Manager (Corporate Planning).

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email only.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number is GMRC/HR/RECT/CP/Sep-2026/24.
